_note: Coverage class of the survey named in a unit's WBADB Survey_Ref, used only to split m (pre-registration §5, Report). 'full' = an ASI-method survey that the WBADB sourcebook (p. 13) counts as full coverage for most of its area. 'partial' = a site-oriented survey: the 1968 Emergency Survey (only known sites, p. 13), problem-oriented surveys, and maps the sourcebook lists under partial coverage. 'none' = no survey named (excavation rows only). A unit whose Survey_Ref names several surveys takes the best class. A survey not listed here counts as 'partial'.
